column1: # Readings the rule table must NOT build: grammatical-looking chains that are not Japanese.
# Columns: input, lemma that must not appear (as spelled in JMdict), why. Used by LemmatizerTest
# in both modes. Each line has a real form next to it in lemma_cases.tsv (category guard).
# Adding a case: put the over-built reading here and fix it with a rule in deinflect_rules.tsv.
# する takes ない on し, ず/ぬ/ん on せ, れる/せる on さ

column3: する + ん is せん, not さん
same: not お手伝い + さ + ん
passive of する is される, not しれる
causative of する is させる, not しせる

column1: # ある's negative is ない itself: no あらない / あんない (あらず, あらぬ are fine)

column3: 案内 is not ある + んない
not a word

column1: # an honorific frame holds the plain 連用形 (or a causative, お待たせする), never potential or passive

column3: not お + 買え + し
待たせ here is the causative of 待つ, not the potential of 待たす

column1: # a one-kana stem is too little for an honorific frame

column3: not お + い + し + そう

column1: # a bare 連用形 is a content verb's, not an auxiliary's after て

column3: 一定 is not 言って + い(る)
not して + い(る)

column1: # ず・ぬ・ん don't attach to the colloquial contractions (てる, ちゃう, とく)

column3: 回転 is not 書いて(る) + ん
not 言って(る) + ん

column1: # Kuromoji's reading needs a rule path of the same word type

column3: verb + だ is not Japanese (the rule path is a na-adjective)
same

column1: # a regular auxiliary (とく: といた) is not reached through 行く's special た form (行った)

column3: not に + とく + て
not とし + とく + た
してる + ん is not a negative
〜てい is not a 中止形 (〜ており、 is)
a potential form takes no passive
